risk_summary: The disclosure is generally precise and transparent, with extensive year-over-year quantification of earnings, margins, deposits, loans, and credit-loss provisions. Key risks include liability-sensitive net interest income, declining asset yields, interest-rate uncertainty, rate-sensitive deposits, and continued COVID-19-related economic uncertainty. Management presents a constructive outlook based on loan growth, lower-cost deposits, and portfolio restructuring, though some forward-looking statements remain non-specific.
